LanguageData.LP_FrostGiant.label: frost giant
LanguageData.LP_FrostGiant.description: A giant race living on ice fields and snowy mountains; the bloodline is passed on to children. Adult frost giants are 2.0 times the size of an ordinary person, with pale blue-grey skin like frozen earth and frost-white hair braided and crusted with ice. They don't get hypothermia even at minus eighty degrees, stride through snow as usual, and winter wolves follow them like hounds; what they fear most is fire, and they can't stand even a little warm weather. Frost giants are born raiders; beating off a raid and seeing the storeroom piled with captured arms and armor is their greatest joy. In the giant ordning, frost giants rank below fire giants, and the two races have been sworn enemies for thousands of years.
LanguageData.LP_FrostGiant.descriptionShort: Inheritable giant race. 2× giant body, extremely cold-hardy, immune to frostbite, hypothermia and chill, no slowdown in snow, tames winter wolves, fears fire and heat, loves loot.
